fact: The Ministry of Spatial Planning's 2024 annual review of the Guichet Unique said it processed more than 2,100 files (gré à gré orders and land titles) and collected 1,170,909,387 FCFA in revenue, 356,792,930 FCFA more than in 2023.
title: Tchad : Le Guichet Unique enregistre des performances exceptionnelles en 2024
publisher: Portail de la Renaissance du Tchad
